name: datadog
description: Query Datadog logs, metrics, traces, incidents, and monitors.

DD_API_KEY.title: Datadog API key
DD_API_KEY.description: API key from a scoped service account (Organization Settings, API Keys). Grant only the permissions the agent needs.

DD_APPLICATION_KEY.title: Datadog application key
DD_APPLICATION_KEY.description: Application key from the same service account (Organization Settings, Application Keys), scoped to the permissions the agent needs.
